parsed.rationale: All three types — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each carries an exact-duplicate `displayName` computed property at line 41 of their respective files. Because the property is structurally identical across three parallel enum-like blend-mode types, a `@DisplayName` attached macro applied at the type declaration site would synthesize the property uniformly and eliminate all three hand-written copies. None of the participating records carry any restraint flags (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies. A macro is preferred over a protocol default-implementation here because the body is synthesized from the type's own case names rather than delegated behaviour, which is the canonical Swift macro use-case.
